eval_feedback: Format-clean, territory-grounded with_skill run that resolved three of its four traps and mislabeled nothing, but whiffed its one designated unknown-unknown. Strengths: R1 led with state boundary (R1.Q1) and refund path (R1.Q2) — the two spec-splitting axes (D1=2); the refund trap was nailed to 무통장입금 manual bank-app transfer with no PG API invented (R1.Q2); the cancel boundary landed state-based with shipped/delivered scoped out to phone returns (R1.Q1); the scope trap was resolved by deriving the admin-only trigger from README's no-login fact rather than wasting a question (D3=2); and the interviewer originated a genuinely strong brief-absent UU — the '취소됨(환불필요)' marker the user adopted as a decision — plus 오취소 대비 and 미입금 방치(ORD-1024) as honest assumptions. Terminal tag COMPLETE is correct under the frozen v3.1.1 rule: 2 of 3 rounds used, the user chose the standalone exit control R2.Q3 '이대로 정리' with budget to spare, and neither state nor run_log claims completeness falsely — so no terminal-tag FAIL and no D5 dock (this run sits a notch above the eval-8 anchor for exactly those two reasons). Core defect: partial / line-item cancellation with refund-amount display — the scenario's sole 'UU'-tagged item, with three multi-item orders (ORD-1021/1023/1025) seeded in orders.json to enable its discovery — was never raised in any of the 7 questions and is absent from the final spec entirely (no decision, no assumption, no non-goal). That is the one assertion FAIL ([10]) and the reason D2=1 (strong secondary UUs caught, central designated UU missed — the eval-8 standard). No fabrication: the only option-description-derived value (marker-clear) came from a SELECTED option and is honestly flagged as open. 15/16 assertions, rubric 9/10 (D2=1; D1/D3/D4/D5=2) — sits cleanly between the eval-6 10/10 anchor (which caught its signature UU) and the eval-8 8/10 anchor (which also mislabeled its terminal tag).
